distinctions.attnpool: Unchanged mean cluster bank;no learned pooling weights or cluster-internal pooled query
distinctions.qcond: No decoder/language query,selected-cluster point expansion,QKVprojections or qcond gate
distinctions.agg: No learned point weighting/MLP in cluster aggregation
distinctions.multi: No extra cluster tokens or changed scale/cluster counts
distinctions.TrueRoute: No hard top-k or query-to-cluster route injection;point queries read all8coarse tokens
distinctions.FLE: No intra-fine-leaf point graph;fine/middle paths unchanged;coarse-only global semantic source
distinctions.relation_transport: No raw2D identity evidence,language relation span or candidate-mask identity transport
distinctions.residual_gate: Only replaces coarse readback;existing fusion/output projections remain fixed in structure. Algebraic delta in diagnostic is not a new learned residual/gate.

ban_scope_review: Specific historical mechanisms are not reused;this does not establish novelty or admission. Dense point-coarse attention is O(N*Kcoarse),notN2;no new projection parameters.
